summary: Regression check after converting PEP 604 unions (X | None) to typing.Optional[X] in routers/admin.py and routers/screens.py for Python 3.9 self-hosted deploy compatibility. All 6 targeted endpoints work as expected. Sandbox runs Python 3.11 so runtime bug never reproduced here; verified behavior is unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: Only 4 spots were converted (admin.py x2, screens.py x2). A repo-wide grep of `| None` in routers/ now returns 0 matches, confirming coverage of the touched files. Recommend main agent also grep other modules (services/, models/, utils/) before shipping to Python 3.9 to catch any remaining PEP 604 usage in non-router modules.
Suggest adding a CI check with `python -m compileall` under Python 3.9 to catch future PEP 604 regressions before deploy.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test schedule 'TEST_regression_schedule' created and deleted within test_schedule_create_list_delete. No leftover data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_optional_regression.py covers: GET /api/admin/users (with & without org_id), GET /api/schedules (with & without screen_id), POST/GET/DELETE /api/schedules full cycle, POST /api/screens/{id}/content/existing with media_ids list. Note the endpoint accepts 'media_ids' (list), not 'media_id'; admin orgs list is /api/admin/organizations.
rca of the issue: PEP 604 union syntax `X | None` is evaluated at runtime for function annotations. On Python 3.9, `type | None` raises TypeError because __or__ was only added to `type` in Python 3.10. Fix: replace with typing.Optional[X], which is a subscripted generic and evaluates fine on 3.9+. All 4 spots converted; regression tests confirm 200s on all affected endpoints.
